package.name: trajectory_waypoint_generator
package.description: Robot-specific glue over control/trajectory_shapes: picks a shape (line, ellipse, circle, square), FK/IK-solves it against the real robot model, and writes the result as a numbered joint-angle waypoint run into a sequence.yaml - so it replays through the existing PlanToJointSequence pipeline. Formula-driven alternative to hand-recording every waypoint with waypoint_recorder --loop.
